en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about ornamenting the women with the gold and the silver. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about women’s using gold and silver as ornaments. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
